variants.headline: Accident at a workplace
variants.body: An accident has occurred at {facility}. Give {target} a fair hearing; outrage alone should not be allowed to write the whole verdict.

variants.headline: Workplace safety becomes immediate news
variants.body: The workplace {facility} has had an accident. Give {target} a fair hearing; outrage alone should not be allowed to write the whole verdict.

variants.headline: An accident enters the working day
variants.body: There has been an accident at {facility}. Give {target} a fair hearing; outrage alone should not be allowed to write the whole verdict.
